kxsre01.title: Virgo silently reviews a first date
kxsre01.caption:
Virgo scored the arrival a 4 before the jacket was even the right way out.
Then Sag remembered the puppy and gave up the last dumpling. Ever been wrong about a first impression?

kxsre02.title: Scorpio and the six phone checks
kxsre02.caption:
Six phone checks, and Scorpio braced for the worst every time.
Check six was the group chat cheering them on. What did you assume last time someone checked their phone?

kxsre03.title: Capricorn meets the texter in person
kxsre03.caption:
Three months of all-caps texts, then a hug-handshake collision at the door.
The quiet ended with both of them snorting at the same second. Who is louder in texts than in person?
